v.t: Say, “It was revealed to me that a band of jinn listened in, and said, ‘We have heard a wondrous Quran
v.l: Qul 'Uhiya 'Ilayya 'Annahu Astama`a Nafarun Mina Al-Jinni Faqalu 'Inna Sami`na Qur'anaan `Ajabaan

v.t: It guides to rectitude, so we have believed in it; and we will never associate anyone with our Lord
v.l: Yahdi 'Ila Ar-Rushdi Fa'amanna Bihi Wa Lan Nushrika Birabbina 'Ahadaan

v.t: And Exalted is the Grandeur of our Lord—He never had a mate, nor a child
v.l: Wa 'Annahu Ta`ala Jaddu Rabbina Ma Attakhadha Sahibatan Wa La Waladaan

v.t: But the fools among us used to say nonsense about God
v.l: Wa 'Annahu Kana Yaqulu Safihuna `Ala Allahi Shatataan

v.t: And we thought that humans and jinn would never utter lies about God
v.l: Wa 'Anna Zananna 'An Lan Taqula Al-'Insu Wa Al-Jinnu `Ala Allahi Kadhibaan

v.t: Some individual humans used to seek power through some individual jinn, but they only increased them in confusion
v.l: Wa 'Annahu Kana Rijalun Mina Al-'Insi Ya`udhuna Birijalin Mina Al-Jinni Fazaduhum Rahaqaan

v.t: They thought, as you thought, that God would never resurrect anyone
v.l: Wa 'Annahum Zannu Kama Zanantum 'An Lan Yab`atha Allahu 'Ahadaan

v.t: We probed the heaven, and found it filled with stern guards and projectiles
v.l: Wa 'Anna Lamasna As-Sama'a Fawajadnaha Muli'at Harasaan Shadidaan Wa Shuhubaan

v.t: We used to take up positions to listen in; but whoever listens now finds a projectile in wait for him
v.l: Wa 'Anna Kunna Naq`udu Minha Maqa`ida Lilssam`i Faman Yastami`i Al-'Ana Yajid Lahu Shihabaan Rasadaan

v.t: We do not know whether ill is intended for those on earth, or if their Lord intends goodness for them
v.l: Wa 'Anna La Nadri 'Asharrun 'Urida Biman Fi Al-'Arđi 'Am 'Arada Bihim Rabbuhum Rashadaan

v.t: Some of us are righteous, but some of us are less than that; we follow divergent paths
v.l: Wa 'Anna Minna As-Salihuna Wa Minna Duna Dhalika Kunna Tara'iqa Qidadaan

v.t: We realized that we cannot defeat God on earth, and that we cannot escape Him by fleeing
v.l: Wa 'Anna Zananna 'An Lan Nu`jiza Allaha Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Lan Nu`jizahu Harabaan

v.t: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord fears neither loss, nor burden
v.l: Wa 'Anna Lamma Sami`na Al-Huda 'Amanna Bihi Faman Yu'umin Birabbihi Fala Yakhafu Bakhsaan Wa La Rahaqaan

v.t: Among us are those who are submitting, and among us are the compromisers. As for those who have submitted—it is they who pursue rectitude
v.l: Wa 'Anna Minna Al-Muslimuna Wa Minna Al-Qasituna Faman 'Aslama Fa'ula'ika Taharraw Rashadaan

v.t: But as for the compromisers—they will be firewood for Hell.’”
v.l: Wa 'Amma Al-Qasituna Fakanu Lijahannama Hatabaan

v.t: Had they kept true to the Path, We would have given them plenty water to drink
v.l: Wa 'Allawi Astaqamu `Ala At-Tariqati L'asqaynahum Ma'an Ghadaqaan
w: surely We (would) have given them to drink

v.t: To test them with it. Whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will direct him to torment ever mounting
v.l: Linaftinahum Fihi Wa Man Yu`riđ `An Dhikri Rabbihi Yasluk/hu `Adhabaan Sa`adaan

v.t: The places of worship are for God. So do not call, besides God, upon anyone else
v.l: Wa 'Anna Al-Masajida Lillahi Fala Tad`u Ma`a Allahi 'Ahadaan

v.t: And when the servant of God got up calling on Him, they almost fell on him in a mass
v.l: Wa 'Annahu Lamma Qama `Abdu Allahi Yad`uhu Kadu Yakununa `Alayhi Libadaan

v.t: Say, “I pray only to my Lord, and I never associate anyone with Him.”
v.l: Qul 'Innama 'Ad`u Rabbi Wa La 'Ushriku Bihi 'Ahadaan

v.t: Say, “It is not in my power to harm you, nor to bring you to right conduct.”
v.l: Qul 'Inni La 'Amliku Lakum Đarraan Wa La Rashadaan

v.t: Say, “No one can protect me from God, and I will not find any refuge except with Him
v.l: Qul 'Inni Lan Yujirani Mina Allahi 'Ahadun Wa Lan 'Ajida Min Dunihi Multahadaan

v.t: Except for a proclamation from God and His messages. He who defies God and His Messenger—for him is the Fire of Hell, in which they will dwell forever.”
v.l: Illa Balaghaan Mina Allahi Wa Risalatihi Wa Man Ya`si Allaha Wa Rasulahu Fa'inna Lahu Nara Jahannama Khalidina Fiha 'Abadaan

v.t: Until, when they see what they were promised, they will know who is weaker in helpers, and fewer in numbers
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Ra'aw Ma Yu`aduna Fasaya`lamuna Man 'Ađ`afu Nasiraan Wa 'Aqallu `Adadaan

v.t: Say, “I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Lord will extend it for a period.”
v.l: Qul 'In 'Adri 'Aqaribun Ma Tu`aduna 'Am Yaj`alu Lahu Rabbi 'Amadaan

v.t: The Knower of the Invisible; He does not disclose His Invisible to anyone
v.l: Alimu Al-Ghaybi Fala Yuzhiru `Ala Ghaybihi 'Ahadaan

v.t: Except to a Messenger of His choosing. He then dispatches guards before him and behind him
v.l: Illa Mani Artađa Min Rasulin Fa'innahu Yasluku Min Bayni Yadayhi Wa Min Khalfihi Rasadaan

v.t: That He may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord. He encompasses what they have, and has tallied everything by number
v.l: Liya`lama 'An Qad 'Ablaghu Risalati Rabbihim Wa 'Ahata Bima Ladayhim Wa 'Ahsa Kulla Shay'in `Adadaan
